matches.rationale: No finding addresses the ShapeLLM backbone/affordance-reasoning capability claim in Section 3.1; all three findings focus on equation-level issues (Eq. 8 variance, Eq. 10 penetration loss, Eq. 28 SmoothRate) unrelated to the MLLM backbone's affordance reasoning mismatch.

GT2 concerns a logical contradiction between 'training-free' refinement, gradient-based iterative adjustment, and classifier-free guidance masking. Finding 2 critiques Eq. 10's penetration loss for not actually measuring penetration—a different, orthogonal technical issue, not the training-free/gradient contradiction described in GT2.
